0be308cb-4508-4daf-98ef-9fc53ced79b8.quote: Prophecy adds magical on-hit damage and attack speed to Phase's own basic attacks. Tainted Scepter puts 45% healing reduction on anyone her magical damage touches, the right tool against Greystone's and Kira's healing. Galaxy Greaves adds both armors. The common core runs Marshal and Enra's Blessing instead, buffing nearby allies' attack speed and shielding immobilized allies. Phase chose personal damage plus anti-heal over ally utility. The record cannot show how often the anti-heal was applied.

66b1d403-af84-4f1c-bf87-57e0c41df0ba.quote: The engine does not model support Eternals, so this is a fit read. Lotus rolls a small random bonus every two minutes and on takedowns. The field on Phase mostly runs Exarch, whose heal-triggered attack speed and magical on-hit would land on a Linked Murdock, at the cost of Lotus's stacking bonuses.
